lines.text: (On a night in Knossos filled with only thick darkness, Talos frowns while looking at the sky.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: There is so much interest in Knossos. Won't the people of the goddess come, won't the demons come? Now… .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: … Even Talos, whom I stepped on, is coming to visit me.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Talos, I know why you woke. But, I hope it doesn't happen again... .
Now step away.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: You, who had not been seen for a long time, have come now... .
Yes, that's right. To talk to your brother.
(A large staff extends out of the darkness and taps Talos on the shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I am not the one to fall victim to foolish moves. This power... . Ugh… . what… ?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: This is... .
A part of the night to come, the power awakened by the sinner of Eastland... . It is ‘bondage’.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Damn… , Daphne… .
(A woman named Daphne smiles brightly and puts away her staff. She then looks up at the tall Talos, whose unusually large and long ears perk up.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I'd like to speak to Talos. Before Minos sensed my presence and exploded in anger.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Okay, back off.
(Talos lowers his head and opens his eyes again, and Daphne quietly calls his name.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Talos.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Daphne.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Let me ask you just one question. Did you wake Pasiphae and Minos?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Yes, because I felt like it had to be that way. However, my brother couldn't use another trick to make them come out.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I couldn't bring the golem.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: That's okay. Thanks to that, that child was able to come here too.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: What will this sinner of Eastland do? What effect will it have on the night Daphne waits for? .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Well, hehe. How about waiting for now? Anyway, the night is not just one, but it is long... .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Talos, you must be tired. Get some rest.
(Daphne extends her staff and taps Talos on the shoulder, and Talos loses consciousness and falls to the floor.)
(Daphne, after checking the condition of the fallen Talos, quietly moves her gaze to the night sky.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I helped the sinner whom you sent according to your will. However, I didn't know that that choice would strangle our clan, including Knossos.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: So now I will do what I want.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: The night we will meet depends on the hand of the goddess who will greet the sinner... .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: So, were you waiting for me?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Hey, thanks for saving me... .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: What do you do with something like that? You stupidly almost became a key. Thanks to this, Deimos almost came sooner than expected... , it's okay.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: So you run away like you always do. And struggle. That would be fun... .

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: … Do you want that too?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Of course. You, me, and they are all the same... . Not for me right now though.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: So… .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I run away, waiting for the night when I will be caught someday... . please!! For my pleasure!!
